title: Platformer: one level, score, win/lose, restart
desc: Child of the platformer epic. Deliverable: the level (data-driven array of platform rectangles, at least 6, plus a goal flag and at least 3 collectibles or hazards), a score or timer shown on screen, win and lose states, and a restart that fully resets state (no leaked variables between runs). ACCEPTANCE: level data is separate from the physics code so a new level is only data; the win state is reachable in under 60 seconds of normal play (say how you know); lose is reachable and recoverable via restart; restarting twice in a row leaves identical state (prove it with the same determinism harness as the physics child, if it exists by then); README documents the level format. Last child finished runs the parent epic acceptance checklist.
